2_motivation:
the batch-2 verdict row **B2-D1** reads **`preempted-but-MF-composition-open (cite)`**, open column verbatim — *"Published halves: cryptographic dataset<->checkpoint attestation (adversarial), position-state binding (duplicate consumption), invariant-based silent-error detection (in-process correctness), structural staleness propagation (no hash). **Open**: the scoring-correctness predicate itself; **separate train/test hashing** as the discriminator between the 18 pfc (train box swap => invalid) and 18 allen_cahn (test trim => valid) legs — uncited anywhere; and the empirical rule pricing on a scored MF corpus (859 legs, 20 ground-truth stale). **Caveat**: the build-system framing failed twice with a tool error — retry in batch 3 before any novelty language ships."*
  This card is that predicate, that discriminator and that pricing — extended where the regime forces it: in an LF-at-train-only benchmark the honest partition is not train/test but **six roles** (`train_cond`, `train_hf`, `train_lf`, `test_cond`, `test_hf`, `test_lf`), because a train-LF-only change invalidates an LF-consuming arm and is a no-op for a condition-only arm on the *identical* dataset. Secondary deliverables quote **B2-D3** (*"**Open**: that a *frozen benchmark reference floor* is the output of an unstable test — measured 3.08e-1 relative move, 53 % NN re-selection, 8.4e6x amplification, invisible to every hash/seam check."*) and **B2-D4** (*"**Open**: fit-set-size matching between a reference arm and the scored arm."*); **B2-D2** is executed as pure **adoption** per its `preempted (cite)` verdict (*"Adopt with citation; do not claim."*).
  Card-level honesty flag, carried verbatim: *"the build-system/content-addressed-cache framing of B2-D1 never completed (two tool errors). Until batch 3 retries it, B2-D1's write-up must say 'not refuted, not confirmed on that angle' rather than 'nothing close found'."*
  B1 part 7 `next_direction` makes this priority (1): *"require every family to write, into last.pt at every save, the state/data_hashes.json sha256 of every dataset it read, with TRAIN arrays and TEST arrays hashed SEPARATELY (the ac case proves a test-only change must not invalidate weights while the pfc case proves a train change must)."*
3_description:
- **New tool `tools/ckpt_data_binding.py`** (added; **nothing existing is edited**): role-partitions each dataset's array files by on-disk layout (`npz_l*` and `ifc_raw`) into the six roles, emits `{role: sha256}` + `union_sha256`, and provides `record` / `verify-legs` / `price-rules`. **Backwards-compat seam**: `union_sha256` must reproduce `preflight/data_binding.py`'s recorded per-dataset `sha256` byte-exactly on all 6 datasets in `state/data_hashes.json`, and the role census must be exhaustive + disjoint on all 10 `floors.json` datasets.
  - **New family helper `models_r3/_common/ckpt_binding.py`**: writes `data_binding = {ds: {roles, union_sha256, roles_read, tool_version, recorded_utc}}` into `<ckpt_dir>/last.pt` at every save. `data_binding` is already in `zero_work_resume_scan.py`'s `BINDING_KEYS`, so its coverage counter reads the block with **no edit to that tool**; the action predicate lives in the new tool.
  - **Predicate**: `RETRAIN` iff `executed_steps == 0` and any role in `roles_read intersect {train_*}` mismatches; else `RESCORE` if `test_cond`/`test_hf` mismatch; else `REREFERENCE` if `test_lf` mismatch (copy-LF denominator only); else `NONE`.
  - **D1 fixture** — read-only copies of `sharp__sod_1d` (npz, guard, 834 KB), `fluid` (npz, guard, 8.6 MB) and `ifc_heat` (ifc_raw, 4.6 MB): both on-disk layouts. Six labelled mutation classes applied **to the copy only** — M0 none / M1 train-HF+cond perturbation (pfc box-swap analogue) / M2 test trim (ac analogue) / M3 test-LF only (denominator only) / M4 train row permutation (content-identical; **declared conservative blind spot**, excluded from the FPR denominator by pre-registration) / **M5 train-LF only (the discriminator)**. Two arms with different `roles_read`: `cond_only` (B1's certifier, byte-identical network) and `lf_at_train` (adds an auxiliary MSE on the **ADR r2-0001 registered** LF residual — §12 registration-of-lifts rule, never a bare `F.interpolate`). Legs: 18 v0 training + 108 resume = **126** at contract tier. Class counts: 27 RETRAIN / 18 RESCORE / 18 REREFERENCE / 27 NONE / 18 blind-spot. Six rules priced on the identical legs (in-job paired control per the drift-class rule): R1 role binding, R2 whole-dataset hash, R3 train/test split without `roles_read`, R4 `ckpt_older_than_result`, R5 `train_seconds_collapsed`, R6 global `--data-changed-after`; 4-class confusion matrix + Wilson 95 % intervals. Plus an **UNSCOPED** live-corpus coverage audit over 8 roots (B1 part 7: *"verification scoped to the known blast radius cannot bound the blast radius"*) and the anchor-consumer walk that closes B1's residual pfc question.
  - **D2** — `floor_precision_seam.py --nn-stability` re-measured at an **independent** dither seed (1) and B = 64 (B1: seed 0, B = 8) over 10 datasets x 3 arms; emit `floor_tolerances.json` with `tol[ds] = max(1e-9, band)`; then Titolo et al.'s remedy shape — drop **fit-set-zero-variance** condition dimensions from the standardized distance, record the dropped dims in the floor certificate, re-measure every band.
  - **D3** — emit `noise_floor_candidate_v2.json` adding `mdd_reference_unobservable` (shipped `preflight.cell_stability_check`, n_boot 10000, seed 0) and `tau_abs_conservative = max(tau_abs_certified, tau_rel + mdd_ref * skill_level)` on the two paper-bar cells, with the surrogate re-validated on the copy-LF cells and the ch failure declared. Written as **adoption** (Batson et al.: no-imputation discouraged; conservative imputation + sensitivity analysis; arXiv:2605.28873 for the pre-registration template and the analytic reference-SD move). The probe never writes `state/`.
  - **D4** — refit `affine_on_hf_train` / `train_mean` / `nn_condition` at the scored arm's fit-set size (n = 320) beside the recorded 400-row fit on the 5 scored cells, `@full` refits asserted equal to `floors.json` at 1e-12, deltas reported **in units of the certified `tau_rel`**. Recommendation only — **no floor is re-frozen by this card**. Anti-citation recorded on the card: the "matched sample size protocol / matched-n interval" phrasing is an unattributed search-engine synthesis and must not appear.

  Recipe notes. `base_commit` = `round3-substrate` HEAD resolved at design time (`git rev-parse round3-substrate` -> `44f2404a...`, the substrate B1 shipped on). **`datasets` MUST stay the explicit fixture list** — the literal `panel` resolves through `round2/project.yaml` to the ROUND-2 panel, which would both score the wrong datasets and make a diagnostic card touch real panel cells. `epochs: 2` is `project.yaml tiers.contract_epochs` verbatim and is deliberate: the contract tier produced 53 of the 62 `train_seconds_collapsed` false alarms, so it is the right regime in which to price that rule. Timing: 126 contract-tier legs at 0.41-4.89 s of training each plus fixture I/O; request the project.yaml default `02:00:00`, `gpu:nvidia_h200:1`, mail `END,FAIL`. D2/D3/D4 are training-free probes in the same job.
4_expected_result:
1. **D1 pricing** — R1: RETRAIN 27/27, RESCORE 18/18, REREFERENCE 18/18, **0/27 false RETRAIN** (Wilson 95 % upper bound 0.126). Ablations on the identical legs: **R2** cannot emit RESCORE/REREFERENCE at all (0/18, 0/18) and makes **45** false RETRAIN calls out of 90 mutated legs; **R3** makes **9/27** false RETRAIN (FPR 0.333) — the size of the MF role increment; **R4** FPR 27/27; **R5** FPR ~27/27 (replicating B1's 859-leg pricing under control); **R6** FPR 27/27.
  2. **D1 coverage** — 0 today on every live leg across 8 roots (B1: 0/18 on the flagged legs) -> **126/126** on this card's own legs; the unscoped audit reproduces the 36 zero-work legs (18 pfc, 18 allen_cahn) and the anchor-consumer walk returns yes/no on B1's residual pfc question.
  3. **D2 tolerances** — B1's bands reproduce within 2x on 10/10 at seed 1 / B = 64, `band(B=64) >= band(B=8)` on >= 8/10; pinned `max(1e-9, band)` moves 4 of 10 off 1e-9 (fluid 1.005e-8, ifc_heat 7.854e-9, heat_local 5.457e-9, ifc_poisson 2.297e-9); under the new ifc_heat tolerance B1's F1 fire (1.1056e-9) no longer fires, i.e. the metrology-limited adjudication becomes structural.
  4. **D2 unstable test** — sod_1d's `nn_condition` band drops from 3.078e-1 to < 1e-6 and NN re-selection from 53 % to 0 % once the zero-variance dimension is dropped; the other nine datasets move < 1e-12. sod_1d is a **guard** cell: no scored number moves.
  5. **D3** — `mdd_reference_unobservable` ~ 0.211 / ~ 0.153, `tau_abs_conservative` 0.3563 / 1.4827 (2.17x / 2.15x the certified constants); no live claim flips.
  6. **D4** — gap shifts at n = 320, in units of certified `tau_rel`: allen_cahn 0.9128/18.6198 = **0.049x**, fisher_kpp 4.0627/10.3128 = **0.394x**, cahn_hilliard 0.2233/0.3612 = **0.618x**; both ifc cells predicted < 0.3x. Seam real, systematically flattering the reference arm, **sub-verdict**.

  **Δ vs anchor**: not defined — the card scores no panel cell and therefore moves nothing against the launch best-floor geomean **34.4198** or the stream's own B1 certification package (panel 19.6438).

  **vs the certified noise floor**: D1/D2/D3 are not score-bearing (counts, byte identities, metrology bands), so they carry pre-registered FP/FN rates with Wilson 95 % intervals and an independent re-measurement of the metrology estimator instead of a skill threshold. **D4 is the one skill-valued clause**, and its firing threshold is *strictly greater than* each cited cell's certified `tau_rel` from `state/anchors_repaired/noise_floor.json`: allen_cahn **18.6198**, fisher_kpp **10.3128**, cahn_hilliard **0.3612**, ifc_poisson **0.6910**, ifc_heat **0.1640** (panel `seed_mce` 0.5083 for context). Predicted shifts sit at 0.049x / 0.394x / 0.618x of those floors, so the clause is neither vacuous nor sub-floor. **`sharp__phase_field_crystal_2d` is report-only (ADR r3-0004) and is enumerated in NO falsification clause** — it appears only as a metrology row in D2's 10-dataset census and as the narrative motivating case in D1.
expected_falsification: the hypothesis — *"a role-resolved checkpoint<->data content binding is the exact scoring-correctness witness for this regime: it recovers the required remedy (retrain / rescore / re-reference) on a labelled MF mutation corpus with zero false retrains, strictly dominating both the whole-dataset hash and the round's wall-clock rules; the round's F1-class tolerances are metrology-limited and its one discontinuous floor arm is an unstable test with a no-op remedy; and the reference-side terms the round is missing (unobservable paper-bar noise, 400-vs-320 fit sets) are real but sub-verdict"* — is falsified if ANY of: **(G1)** R1 fails 27/27 · 18/18 · 18/18 recall with 0/27 false RETRAIN, **or** the whole-dataset-hash ablation R2 makes 0 false RETRAIN calls on M2 union M3 (the train/test split buys nothing), **or** the no-roles ablation R3 also attains 0/27 (the MF role increment is empty); **(G2)** the role partition's `union_sha256` fails to reproduce `preflight/data_binding.py`'s recorded `sha256` on any of the 6 manifest datasets, or the role census is not exhaustive/disjoint on any of the 10 `floors.json` datasets, or `data_binding.py verify` is not MATCH 6/6 at **both** job start and job end; **(G3)** the re-measured ULP bands (seed 1, B = 64) disagree with B1's table by > 2x relative on >= 2 of 10 datasets, or `band(B=64) < band(B=8)` on >= 3 of 10; **(G4)** dropping zero-variance fit-set condition dimensions fails to bring `sharp__sod_1d`'s `nn_condition` band below 1e-6 (from 3.078e-1), or changes any floor arm on the other nine datasets by > 1e-12; **(G5)** refitting the reference arms at n = 320 shifts the gap by **more than** that cell's certified `tau_rel` on >= 1 of the 5 scored cells (allen_cahn 18.6198, fisher_kpp 10.3128, cahn_hilliard 0.3612, ifc_poisson 0.6910, ifc_heat 0.1640) — which must be escalated to the operator as a fair-comparison defect, not absorbed — or the `@full` refit fails to reproduce `floors.json` at 1e-12.
